definitions.supplemental: In the Domesday of St. Paul's of the year 1222 (Camden Society, 1858) is this entry: ' Debent dare de singulis animalibus . iij. ob' UNCERTAIN annum si ad pasturam dm venerint similiter de equis et de singulis porcis .j. þ. UNCERTAIN Garsavese, ' p. 51. See also note p. lxviii on garsavese, where another instance of its use is given as well as an instance of a verb avesare (avesabit porcos).
definitions.meaning: Produce of woods on which swine might be fed

quotations.old_english: Mid mæste and mid æuesan . . . and ic ann þæt þridde swun (?) of æuesan þæs nēxtan wudes þe līþ tō kyngesbyrig
quotations.latin: cum porcorum esca et cum fructibus . . . quoaue dono tertiam sarcinam iumentariam fructuum qui nascuntur in sylua proxime ad kyngesbyrig sita

source_text: æfesa (-e; f, f), an; m. Produce of woods on which swine might be fed :-- Mid mæste and mid æuesan . . . and ic ann &d-bar;æt &d-bar;ridde swun (?) of æuesan &d-bar;æs n&e-long;xtan wudes &d-bar;e l&i-long;þ t&o-long; kyngesbyrig cum porcorum esca et cum fructibus . . . quoaue dono tertiam sarcinam iumentariam fructuum qui nascuntur in sylua proxime ad kyngesbyrig sita, C. D. iv. 202, 2-12. [In the Domesday of St. Paul's of the year 1222 (Camden Society, 1858) is this entry: ' Debent dare de singulis animalibus . iij. ob' UNCERTAIN annum si ad pasturam dm venerint similiter de equis et de singulis porcis .j. &d-bar;. UNCERTAIN Garsavese, ' p. 51. See also note p. lxviii on garsavese, where another instance of its use is given as well as an instance of a verb avesare (avesabit porcos).] v. æfesn, æfes-weorc.
